verdict.rationale: Inline completions are a fair axis for an AI coding assistant, but the evidence documents no inline or next-edit suggestions as you type for Aider. Aider works through chat-driven edits, and its --watch-files mode only acts on explicit AI!/AI? comments after a file is saved. That watch mode is an adjacent feature, not as-you-type completion.

support.subject: As a developer, I can receive inline code completions and next-edit suggestions as I type
